item.title: [UI & Layout] Foldable UI: Duo-Screen Adaptive Blueprint
item.description: The rise of foldable form factors like 'iPhone Duo' demands a fluid, adaptive UI. This pattern ensures seamless user experience across varied screen states (folded, unfolded, outer display), converting engagement by minimizing friction and maximizing utility in novel interaction paradigms. | Fonts: Inter Variable + Roboto Mono | Palette: #1E293B #64748B #E2E8F0 #F8FAFC | Prompt: Design a responsive e-commerce product detail page for a foldable device (e.g., iPhone Duo).
